name: John Muir Health High School Student Volunteer Program (Walnut Creek Medical Center)
what_you_do: The program is being rebuilt. In the past, students helped staff, patients and visitors at Walnut Creek Medical Center and built job and leadership skills.
who_can_apply: Current rules are not posted while the program is being rebuilt. Past rules: at least 14.5 years old, second-semester freshman or higher, 3.0 GPA, through a partner high school.
pay_detail: Volunteer role; no pay stated on the page
duration: Past program: one 3-hour shift a week through senior year
deadline_text: Not open as of Nov 2, 2026. The page says more information is expected in Spring 2027.
how_to_apply: Not open now. Check the program page in Spring 2027. The volunteer office says it cannot answer emails about dates.
notes: The page says the program is under construction. It no longer lists age, GPA, partner schools or shifts, so the past rules here may change. A separate Concord program says to check back in March 2027. This was an unpaid volunteer role.
